about_short_description.short_description: Nextpower Arabia drives solar across the (MENA) with advanced tracker systems designed to perform in desert climates and on complex terrain.

product.name: Integrated Utility-Scale Solar Infrastructure Platform
product.description: An integrated platform combining solar trackers, electrical balance-of-system equipment, software, and robotics for utility-scale solar power projects.

product.name: Solar Trackers
product.description: Solar tracking systems that orient photovoltaic panels to improve energy capture in utility-scale projects, including installations in desert climates and complex terrain.

product.name: Electrical Balance of System (eBOS)
product.description: Electrical balance-of-system equipment and infrastructure used to connect, organize, and support photovoltaic modules within utility-scale solar plants.

product.name: Solar Software
product.description: Software for supporting the design, deployment, and operational management of utility-scale solar projects through connected digital systems and project data.

product.name: Solar Robotics
product.description: Robotic equipment and systems that support installation and operational activities at utility-scale solar power plants.

identifier.value: Solar Project Design and Engineering Support

product.name: Solar Project Design and Engineering Support
product.description: Project support from solar system design through deployment, including coordination of technical requirements for site conditions, logistics, and installation.
